title: anacamptis × ticinensis
intro: Anacamptis × ticinensis, commonly known as Ticino orchid or Ticino Anacamptis, is a hybrid orchid species resulting from the cross between Anacamptis coriophora and Anacamptis papilionacea. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Anacamptis × ticinensis include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties, which can soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
